sentences.en: Meanwhile, things are getting surreal with Mark Higgs.

sentences.en: Finally, the MSSM parameters must also be consistent with a minimum in the Higgs potential which leads to the observed electroweak boson masses.

sentences.en: Now Higgs has codified the modern thinking that executives are indeed mere managers and boards should comprise a majority of non-executives.

sentences.en: A scathing review in the Higgs Report three years ago called for a complete shake-up of the system.

sentences.en: Such a low Higgs mass would indicate that supersymmetry theory may be true.

sentences.en: So Guy 's made Higgs & Hill happy with a revised contract price and wrap-up deal at £ 84.3m.
